Xeljanz, Xeljanz XR (tofacitinib) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-660309  
Guideline Name 
Xeljanz, Xeljanz XR (tofacitinib)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
8/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: Brand Xeljanz tablets, Brand Xeljanz XR tablets  
Diagnosis 
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis (RA)  


=== PDF PAGE 2018 ===
Page 2018 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within the last 6 
months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist  
Notes  
PA Team Note: To approve products designated "Only Brand Covere
d" or "Brand Over Generic - Not Covered"; flip Brand/Generic Flag to "
Y", approve at MSC "O".

Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  


=== PDF PAGE 2019 ===
Page 2019 
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of active psoriatic arthritis  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 2 years of age or older (Applies to Xeljanz IR tablets and oral solution only)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within the last 6 
months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Rheumatologist  
• 
Dermatologist  
Notes  
PA Team Note: To approve products designated "Only Brand Covere
d" or "Brand Over Generic - Not Covered"; flip Brand/Generic Flag to "
Y", approve at MSC "O". 
 
Product Name:PREFERRED: Brand Xeljanz tablets, Brand Xeljanz XR tablets, Brand Xeljanz 
oral solution  
Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization

Product Name:PREFERRED: Brand Xeljanz tablets, Brand Xeljanz XR tablets  
Diagnosis 
Ulcerative Colitis (UC)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to one of the following conventional therapies at maximally indicated doses within the 
last 3 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced:  
• 
Corticosteroids (e.g., prednisone, methylprednisolone, budesonide)  
• 
6-mercaptopurine (Purinethol)  
• 
Azathioprine (Imuran)  


=== PDF PAGE 2021 ===
Page 2021 
• 
Aminosalicylates (e.g., mesalamine, sulfasalazine)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a gastroenterologist  
Notes

d" or "Brand Over Generic - Not Covered"; flip Brand/Generic Flag to "

Product Name:PREFERRED: Brand Xeljanz tablets, Brand Xeljanz oral solution  
Diagnosis 
Polyarticular Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (PJIA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of active polyarticular course juvenile idiopathic arthritis  
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting trial and 
failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following nonbiologic DMARDs:  
• 
leflunomide  
• 
methotrexate  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist

N/A - Requests for generic tofacitinib should not be approved  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Requests for generic tofacitinib are not authorized and will not be approved  
Notes  
Approval Length: N/A - Requests for generic tofacitinib should not be 
approved. Patients need to use Brand Xeljanz or other preferred alter
natives.
